response.justification: Bogdan meets the minimum requirement of 15 years in software engineering and has a solid background in full-stack, cloud, and infrastructure development. He also shows entrepreneurial spirit as an open-source founder and community contributor. However, this is a Director-level Principal Engineer role focused heavily on AI strategy. Bogdan's AI experience appears limited to very recent tooling work, and he lacks the deep, recognized AI/ML expertise, advanced AI degree, and strategic enterprise advising experience expected at this seniority level.
strengths: Over 15 years of comprehensive software engineering experience across full-stack, cloud, and infrastructure.
Demonstrated entrepreneurial initiative as the founder of GISCollective and an active community speaker.
Recent hands-on exposure to AI-agent infrastructure and Model Context Protocol (MCP) tooling.
concerns: Lacks the deep, recognized AI/ML expertise and strategic product development background required for this role.
Does not demonstrate Director-level engineering leadership or experience advising strategic enterprise customers.
Does not hold the preferred Master's or PhD degree in an AI-related field.
